entries.name: LY4329090
entries.stage: Recruiting subcutaneous Phase 1; no posted results
entries.summary: Lilly's sponsor-submitted record describes recruiting Phase 1 single- and multiple-ascending-dose research of subcutaneous LY4329090 in otherwise healthy adults with obesity or overweight. It records an actual 22 September 2026 start, 184 estimated participants and estimated September 2027 completion.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed trial record does not establish UK marketing authorisation for LY4329090.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by this early research record.
entries.supply: A recruiting Phase 1 trial does not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: No results are posted, and the reviewed registry does not disclose a molecular target or mechanism. The primary questions concern safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics. Recruitment, estimated enrolment and estimated completion are not efficacy, safety, weight-loss or comparative findings, an approved regimen, UK authorisation, NHS access, supply or clinical approval.
